name: tin-vibe-recut
note: Three quiet roles under Noir Now. No extra riser, drop, whoosh or logo sting. These are code-made effects, not recordings.

key.note: A few short taps follow typed prompt words, not every glyph.

land.light.note: Quiet material contacts for the three task notes.

click.note: Selection and approval, without a cinematic impact.

off.suck: off by default: a reverse whoosh into a cut stacks a build onto the reveal
off.riser: off by default; pro_riser/air_gate is the short opt-in, never a shepard riser
off.swell: off by default: the sub swell of whoosh.long already carries the move
